AutoOpen.name: Open the War Room automatically
AutoOpen.hint: Opens the War Room turn HUD when a war is on, and brings it forward when it becomes your turn.

WarRoom.Title: War Room
WarRoom.StartHint: Turn in 4 Resource cards for a Red Star token, as many times as you can afford. Start-of-turn Scar cards are played now.
WarRoom.JoinHint: You control no territory. Join the War: place {troops} troops in a legal starting territory (no new HQ). If there is none, you are eliminated.
WarRoom.PickJoin: Choose a legal starting territory to join the war
WarRoom.TradeTip: Turn in 2–10 coins for troops (chart on the board).
WarRoom.PlacingHint: click your territories to place them · Esc stops
WarRoom.AttackHint: Drag troops onto an empty neighbour to expand, or onto an enemy to attack. Or use the buttons.
WarRoom.ExpandCost: Moving in costs {cost} of those troops (city population, fortification).
WarRoom.PickExpandFrom: Expand from which of your territories?
WarRoom.PickExpandTo: Expand from {from} into which empty territory?
WarRoom.PickAttackFrom: Attack from which of your territories?
WarRoom.ManeuverHint: One maneuver: move any troops (leave one behind) to a territory connected through yours.
WarRoom.NoTargets: No territory qualifies for that right now.
WarRoom.MayDraw: You conquered a territory: you may draw a Resource card.
WarRoom.NoDraw: No territory conquered from an opponent: no Resource card this turn (unless a power says otherwise).
WarRoom.SetupHint: The Gamemaster is setting up this war: players, factions, Red Stars and missiles, scars and the sideboard.
WarRoom.PlacementHint: In pick order, each faction places its HQ and 8 troops in a legal starting territory.
WarRoom.ScarFromBattle: Played from the battle card, before the attack roll (onto the defending territory).
WarRoom.NoWeaknessSlot: No faction has an empty yellow (weakness) slot.
WarRoom.PickScar: {scar}: click a territory without a scar

Reference.Title: Rules Reference
Reference.GoalText: Be the first to hold {goal} Red Stars, or eliminate every other player. You win immediately.
Reference.WayToken: Players who have never signed this board start with a Red Star token.
Reference.WayHQ: Every HQ you control counts as a Red Star, yours or someone else's.
Reference.WayBuy: At the start of your turn, turn in 4 Resource cards for a Red Star token.

StepText.start: Buy Red Stars with 4 Resource cards each. Play start-of-turn Scar cards.
StepText.recruit: No territory? Join the War with 4 troops. Otherwise recruit: (territories + population) ÷ 3, min 3, plus continent bonuses, plus cards turned in. Place them in your territories.
StepText.attack: Optional. Expand into empty neighbours (cities cost their population, fortifications 2). Attack enemy neighbours with up to 3 dice; the defender rolls up to 2.
StepText.maneuver: Optional, once: move troops from one territory to another connected through your own. Leave one behind.
StepText.end: End-of-turn scars. If you conquered at least one territory, draw a Resource card (a territory you control from the row, else a Coin card).

Reference.TimingText: If more than one player wants to play a scar or a missile at once, whoever declared first goes first. If unclear: the current player, then the defender, then clockwise.
Reference.StarNote: Any {count} Resource cards buy a Red Star token, whatever their coins.
Reference.FortRule: +1 to both defence dice. An attack with 3 dice wears off one box.

ScarText.bunker: The defender adds 1 to their higher die.
ScarText.ammo_shortage: The defender subtracts 1 from their higher die.

Faction.Label: Risk Legacy Faction Card
Faction.CardHint: The faction card evolves as the war goes on: stickers fill its coloured brackets.
Faction.CardHintEdit: Drag a Power sticker from the Items directory onto its coloured bracket. Right-click a sticker for more.
Faction.NotInWarLong: This faction isn't fighting in the current war. Its numbers below are from the last time it played.
Faction.RedStarsExplain: Red Star tokens in front of you, plus every HQ you control on the board. Four wins the war.
Faction.NoBoard: territory counts appear once the world board is loaded.
Faction.NoHand: This faction has no hand of cards yet.
Faction.HistoryHint: Write in the player and starting territory; click W / H / E to mark the result. Right-click a row to mark it X (not played) or clear it.

Power.Label: Risk Legacy Power Sticker
Power.RemoveContent: {name} comes off the {faction} card and is destroyed. Stickers don't survive being peeled.
Power.OnlyPowers: Only Power stickers fit on a faction card.
Power.CannotPlace: Only the Gamemaster places stickers (owners may during first-game setup).
Power.NoSlot: Drop this sticker onto a coloured bracket.
Power.WrongSlot: That sticker goes in the {slot} slot. Placed it there.
Power.SlotTaken: The {slot} slot already has a sticker. Ask the Gamemaster.
Power.ReplaceContent: {name} goes over {old} in the {slot} slot. The old sticker is destroyed.
Power.OtherFactionContent: {name} was printed for {other}. Put it on {faction} anyway?
Power.Unplaced: Not on any faction card yet
Power.Name: Name

Campaign.Label: Risk Legacy World
Campaign.Title: The World Of ___
Campaign.NameWorldHint: After game 15, the player who signed the victors' section most often names the planet.
Campaign.Pact: We, the undersigned, take responsibility for the wars that are about to start, the decisions we will make, and the history we will write. Everything that is going to happen is going to happen because of us.
Campaign.WarsStarted: The wars started on the following date:
Campaign.EditHint: Gamemaster correction: writes straight onto the board. The wizards do this for you in normal play.
Campaign.NoBoard: the continents appear once the world board is loaded.
Campaign.StickersIntro: What's left on the sticker sheet.
Campaign.PacksNote: Open them when you have satisfied the requirement listed. More than one may open during or after the same game. Yeah, we know you could open them any time you like. Just don't.

PackTrigger.minorcities: Open when all 9 Minor Cities have been founded.
PackTrigger.eliminated: Open the first time a faction is eliminated from the game.
PackTrigger.secondwin: Open when one person gets to sign the board for a second time.
PackTrigger.worldcapital: Open when the World Capital mark is about to go on the board.
PackTrigger.threemissiles: Open as soon as 3 Missiles are used during the same combat roll.
PackTrigger.thirtytroops: Open when a person is about to place 30+ troops on the board and has at least one Missile.

PackWhen.minorcities: At the end of a game.
PackWhen.eliminated: Mid-game or at the end of a game.
PackWhen.secondwin: At the end of a game, after the reward.
PackWhen.worldcapital: In the middle of a game.

Campaign.ChronicleEmpty: Nothing has been written in this world's history yet.
